resources.string: A full-screen oversized clock rendered over your selected wallpaper.

Choose any wallpaper, then preview the live wallpaper. Drag the clock to position it and pinch with two fingers to resize it. The clock is drawn into the wallpaper layer, behind your home-screen icons. Drag the clock to move it; use two fingers to resize it.
One finger: trace an outline · Two fingers: zoom and pan

Choose Add or Erase, then trace around the area with one finger. Magnetic lasso snaps to nearby image edges; turn it off for a freehand polygon. Pinch with two fingers to zoom in and drag with two fingers to pan. Release to close the outline, then save your selection.
Sharp full wallpaper preview. Use Add or Erase lasso modes; pinch with two fingers to zoom and pan.
Choose a wallpaper before editing its foreground.
No wallpaper image selected yet. Choose an image to begin.
Wallpaper imported. The clock will stay visible. Use Select object to trace anything that should appear in front of it.
Wallpaper ready with foreground depth layering.
Wallpaper ready. This image could not be segmented, so the clock will render without foreground overlap.
No image picker is available on this device.
The system live wallpaper preview could not be opened.

Lock Screen note: One UI controls the secure Lock Screen clock and draws it above the wallpaper. This live wallpaper primarily targets the Home Screen. For the Lock Screen, use Samsung native clock settings or Good Lock / LockStar alongside the same wallpaper.
